versions.summary: Built a four-armed mantis humanoid with sage and plum armor, amber eyes, curved antennae, segmented abdomen, veined golden wings, articulated claws, and split taloned feet. Inferred complete rear wing cases, back plates, and hidden joint geometry.

review.summary: The four arms, curved antennae, amber eyes, wings, and green/purple palette make the character recognizable. However, the renders lose substantial reference detail: armor resembles outlined leaves, the abdomen is mostly smooth, eyes protrude as stacked discs, and the legs lack the reference’s angular stance. The side view also exposes disconnected-looking wing placement.
issues: Reshape the leaf-shaped chest, shoulder, and limb plates into broader, overlapping armor that wraps around the body; reduce the raised outline trim.
Expose overlapping abdominal segments across the visible front and back, replacing the large smooth green surface and isolated purple tip plates.
Integrate the eyes into rounded head sockets and reduce the conspicuous dark cylindrical backing visible in profile.
Bring the wing roots into the upper back and curve the folded wings closer to the abdomen; the side view currently shows straight panels standing away from the torso.
Strengthen the bent knee and ankle silhouette and enlarge the grounded, split hooked feet to match the reference’s stance.
Replace bead-like finger joints and thin digits with thicker articulated claws, and refine the rounded muzzle into a continuous insect face mask with integrated mandibles.

versions.summary: Refined the complete four-armed sentinel with broad overlapping armor, front and back abdominal segments, recessed amber eyes, curved attached wings, angular legs, larger grounded feet, thicker claws, and integrated mandibles. Preserved named components and palette; inferred concealed wing hinges, rear armor, and joint connections.

review.summary: The four arms, amber eyes, antennae, segmented abdomen, and veined wings make the character recognizable. However, the renders lose the reference’s elongated neck, broad layered shoulders, tapered armor, and long hooked claws, producing a noticeably stockier, rounded figure.
issues: Expose and lengthen the ribbed neck; the rendered head sits directly against the shoulder armor instead of above a visible armored throat.
Broaden the shoulder mantle and reshape its rounded lobes into overlapping flared plates with defined rims.
Lengthen the fingers and terminal hooks on all four hands, reduce the bulbous palms, and separate the lower left hand from the knee silhouette.
Taper the thigh, forearm, and shin armor and extend plates over their supporting forms; the current short rounded panels and exposed joints look disconnected.
Replace the conspicuous raised vertical eye lines with subtle compound-eye texture and smoother amber shading.
Integrate the wing roots and rear thorax with overlapping dorsal plates; the back currently exposes a large plain dark central surface between the wing cases.
